purpose:
[OPTIMIZED] Specialized single-shot context pill for LLMs prior to editing a file or module.
Combines LIVE module/API/dependency state in one response.
parameters: file_path (string, optional, default ""): target repository-relative or absolute file path.
max_items (integer or null, default 30): maximum number of items in bounded legacy collections; pass null for unlimited.
compact (boolean, default true): when true, returns up to 3 bounded evidence items per non-empty collection with total, truncated, and expand metadata; set to false for full item lists.
fields (array of strings or null, default null): optional projection list of top-level keys to return; null returns the full response.
mode (string or null, default null): execution mode; null preserves default context behavior, while 'minimal' returns an ultra-lightweight in-memory decision projection for fast pre-edit assessment.
target (string or null, default null): flexible target identifier in minimal mode (accepts relative/absolute file path, dotted module name, or module ID).
behavior: 1. mode=null (default): Combines LIVE module, API boundary, direct/transitive consumers, and covering tests. When compact=True, emits collection counts and truncated flags; when compact=False, emits bounded item lists up to max_items.

2. mode='minimal': Returns an ultra-lightweight in-memory pre-edit decision projection (direct and transitive consumer counts, risk metrics, and covering test sample) without reading file bodies from disk.
3. Consumer semantics: direct_count measures unique modules directly importing the target; transitive_count measures all unique modules reachable via reverse dependency traversal.
4. Exposes stale or unavailable canonical truth explicitly. Does not dump whole source files.
freshness: The response includes a ``state_freshness`` envelope scoped to the queried target file or module.

- ``workspace_sync``: ``verified`` (sha256 matches disk), ``metadata_match`` (mtime+size match but sha256 absent), ``out_of_sync`` (file modified on disk since canonical state generation), or ``unverified``.
- DOUBLE WARNING: When ``workspace_sync`` is ``out_of_sync``, a warning message is also added to the top-level ``warnings`` array in the response so legacy consumers see it.
- ``canonical_revision``: Revision of the canonical state used to answer this query.
- ``advisory_warning``: Warning message when out of sync or if the last analysis job was interrupted/failed.
usage_notes:
LLM use: in minimal mode, pass target (file path or module name) prior to editing a file to quickly gauge blast radius and relevant test targets.
Always inspect state_freshness and warnings array before editing.
